scope: Prospective independent OpenMULTI3D1D O41 solve on the exact5750/4.5/A8.70 source atom/atmosphere of the held MULTI reference. Native EOS/background/rate interpolation and boundary differences must be measured. No background line blanketing in this first continuum-only control; no solar fit, physical parity/admission or replacement of Bride/source/production. Second prospective control requests actual disk-centre output and disables per-depth early freezing (convmax0) so all saved depth rates belong to the same final global iteration. The first run was a departure-only calculation with no output spectrum. The native pressure-graded/interpolated depth grid must be registered explicitly before comparing source-node populations.

physical_limitations: Native HOP EOS/continuous opacity and collision interpolation differ from Bride; explicit matched-input audit is required.
Line blanketing and background bound-bound opacity explicitly off in this first reference plan.
Output quadrature is explicit; none skips synthesis and disk_center requests vertical intensity, not flux or an abundance fit.
Source atom is not silently replaced by the supplied variant; source paths and hashes are checked.
